#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1e9 + 7;

int solve(int n) {
    vector<vector<int>> dp0(2 * n + 1, vector<int>(2 * n + 1, 0));
    vector<vector<int>> dp1(2 * n + 1, vector<int>(2 * n + 1, 0));
    dp0[0][0] = 1;
    for (int depth = 1; depth <= 2 * n; depth++) {
        for (int opened = depth & 1; opened <= depth; opened += 2) {
            int val0 = 0, val1 = 0;
            if (opened - 1 >= 0) {
                val0 += dp1[depth - 1][opened - 1];
                val1 += dp0[depth - 1][opened - 1];
            }
            if (opened + 1 <= n) {
                val0 += dp1[depth - 1][opened + 1];
                val1 += dp0[depth - 1][opened + 1];
            }
            val0++;
            dp0[depth][opened] = val0 % MOD;
            dp1[depth][opened] = val1 % MOD;
        }
    }
    return dp1[2 * n][0];
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    cout.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    int ans = solve(n);
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
